description: Reject a payout run that is awaiting approval: nothing is paid and the ledger stays as it was. The requester may reject their own request to withdraw it. 409 when the run is not awaiting approval. Answers 404 while payout runs are not switched on for your workspace (list_payout_runs says so in execution.enabled). Needs a Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

run_id.description: The payout run: id on a list_payout_runs or request_payout_run result.

name: reject_payout_run
